pr_title: statistics: fix a case that auto-analyze is triggered outside its time range
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #23160 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: statistics: fix a case that auto-analyze is triggered outside its time range

### What is changed and how it works?
In the function `NeedAnalyzeTable`, TiDB checks whether the table has been analyzed first, which may let auto-analyze be triggered outside its time range.
The behavior above may confuse users, so this PR let TiDB check the auto-analyze time range first.

issue_context.title: The auto-analyze processing on an unanalyzed table is not controlled by the analyze time range
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
If a table has never been analyzed, TiDB will auto-analyze it when it has not been modified for a while.
But this behavior is not controlled by the time range [auto_analyze_start_time, auto_analyze_end_time], this makes the user confused.

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
TiDB won't auto-analyze this unanalyzed table when it is not in the time range.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
TiDB auto-analyzed this table.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
v4.0.9
